lines.say: blocks mTOR, a pathway tied to lifespan in mice, and suppresses the immune system
some immune, heart and skin aging measures improved (19-study review, with related drugs)
no gain in muscle, hormone or nerve aging measures (19-study review, with related drugs)
no change in visceral fat in a 48-week trial of 114 healthy adults aged 50 to 85
cholesterol and triglycerides rose in 30% or more of transplant patients; checked
kidney function and urine protein checked; protein in the urine is a listed risk
high blood sugar and new diabetes reported; glucose checked
boxed warning: infections, lymphoma and other cancers, from a weakened immune system
wounds heal slowly; skin cancer is also a listed risk
lung inflammation (interstitial lung disease), sometimes fatal
gut complaints in about 1 in 5 healthy older adults vs 1 in 10 on placebo (small trial)

ask: Given my infection history, cholesterol and any planned surgery, what are the risks of rapamycin for me?
